name: Viola
grown_as: William's seed is 'Cool Summer Breeze', given on the packet as Viola × wittrockiana, the garden pansy, 20 cm tall. Flower colour and size depend on the variety and are not known. Drawn as a small-flowered garden pansy, violet-blue with a yellow eye and dark lines. ⚠️ CHECK the variety's colour and whether it is a pansy or a smaller viola.
habit: A low bushy plant 15 to 20 cm tall and about 20 cm across, the leafy stems spreading and branching, flowers held above on long stalks.

leaf.type: Simple, with large leafy stipules at the base of each stalk
leaf.outline: Lower leaves oval to heart-shaped, upper leaves longer and oblong; 2 to 5 cm
leaf.base: Rounded to slightly heart-shaped on lower leaves; tapering on upper ones
leaf.veins: A midrib and a few side veins
leaf.surface: Smooth to slightly hairy, a little glossy
leaf.stalk: Present, with a pair of leafy stipules at its base, each deeply cut into finger-like lobes, the middle lobe largest and leaf-like

flower.form: A flat, open, face-like flower facing sideways
flower.petals: Five, free and unequal: two upper petals overlapping, two side petals and one broad lower petal with a short spur behind
flower.colour: Variety unknown; drawn violet-blue, with dark lines (whiskers) or a dark blotch on the lower three petals
flower.centre: A small yellow eye at the throat, the stigma showing as a tiny knob
flower.behind: Five small, pointed green sepals showing behind the petals; the short spur poking back from the lower petal
flower.carried: Alone on a long stalk from a leaf joint, the stalk bent like a hook at the top so the flower faces out
flower.season: July to September from a spring sowing; summer and autumn sowings flower in winter and spring

fruit: A three-sided egg-shaped capsule that splits into three boat-shaped valves, which squeeze the seeds out. Seeds oval, smooth, glossy, tan to brown, about 1.5 to 2 mm.
seedling: Two small round seed leaves on stalks, then rounded scalloped first leaves
winter: A low tuft of small leaves; may keep flowering in mild spells.

leaf: oval leaf with rounded teeth all round
on a stalk with large leafy stipules cut into finger-like lobes
bloom: five unequal petals: two upper, two side, one broad lower
a yellow eye with dark lines on the lower petals
facing sideways from a hooked stalk
seed: small oval smooth glossy tan seeds
seedling: first true leaves rounded and scalloped
young: a low bushy tuft of oval scalloped leaves with lobed stipules
flower: a low bushy plant with flat face-like flowers held above on long hooked stalks
seedhead: three-sided capsules upright on their stalks, some split into three boat-shaped valves
dormant: a low tuft of small leaves

look_alikes: Wild pansy (Viola tricolor) is smaller (1.5 to 2.5 cm) and often three-coloured. Horned violet (Viola cornuta) has a long slender spur. Dog-violets grow from a rosette, have heart-shaped leaves and narrow, unlobed stipules.
